display.title: Elul: Ending the Year the Right Way
display.summary_short: With Rosh Hashanah around the corner, Elul is the time to finish the year in the spirit of Torah and mitzvos, so that Hashem grants a good and sweet year.
display.summary_long: A one-minute Elul message from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi reminds children that Rosh Hashanah is just around the corner, and that the way to begin a new year correctly is to end the old one in the spirit of Torah and mitzvos. Elul is the last month of the year, and as the Sages say, all's well that ends well. Recalling the previous week's talk, he says that in Elul we try our very best to do Hashem's mitzvos in the best possible way, checking our tefillin and our mezuzos. By doing this we can feel sure that Hashem will grant everyone a kesivah vachasimah tovah, a blessed year that is good for body and soul. The clip is a short excerpt and refers back to an earlier program.
display.lesson: End the year well: in Elul, do the mitzvos as well as you can so the new year starts right.
